title: CLI Entry Point
description: The kaava command-line tool with reconcile subcommand.
body: `kaava` — Schematify's command-line entry point. Today this binary has one subcommand, `reconcile` (`SCHEMATIFY-PRD.md` section 9.3): `kaava reconcile [--root <path>] [--out <path>] [--format text|json]`. A later wave adding another `kaava` subcommand does so by matching on it in `main` below and adding its own module.
